items.title: After price cuts at Gucci, Kering appoints a group director of pricing
items.why: Luxury price cuts may signal softer demand at the top end, which affects affluent spending outlooks.
items.summary_ai: Kering has appointed a group director of pricing after Gucci cut prices.
items.take: Luxury price cuts may signal softer demand at the top end, which affects affluent spending outlooks.
